'''Channel gamma-gamma-eleven''' was a communications channel used by the [[Danoor Resistance]] to contact the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Danoor]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ship ''[[FarStar]]'' transmitted a message from the Resistance to the Aing-Tii, requesting their protection from forces loyal to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
